tags.name: sn-resource
tags.description: a named, page-wide cache of server data

tags.name: sn-event
tags.description: maps one server event to a change message; child of <sn-sync>

tags.name: sn-include
tags.description: inlines a partial at build time

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-state
globalAttributes.description: declares local reactive state for the element and its subtree (object literal)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-text
globalAttributes.description: sets textContent; never HTML (value expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-attr
globalAttributes.description: literal keys; null/false removes, true sets empty; URL values are checked (object literal {href: …})

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-class
globalAttributes.description: toggles each class (object literal {unread: …})

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-style
globalAttributes.description: sets each property with style.setProperty (object literal {'--color': …})

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-show
globalAttributes.description: toggles the hidden attribute (value expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-prop
globalAttributes.description: sets JS properties; custom elements only (object literal)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-model
globalAttributes.description: two-way binding for form controls (state path)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-for
globalAttributes.description: repeats a <template> per item (item in list | (item, i) in list)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-key
globalAttributes.description: row identity; defaults to the resource key or object identity (value expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-if
globalAttributes.description: renders a <template> while truthy (value expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-else
globalAttributes.description: on a <template> directly after an if template

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-persist
globalAttributes.description: persists the model or state in localStorage under sn: (storage key)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-get
globalAttributes.description: GET action; latest wins (URL template)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-post
globalAttributes.description: POST action (URL template)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-put
globalAttributes.description: PUT action (URL template)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-patch
globalAttributes.description: PATCH action (URL template)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-delete
globalAttributes.description: DELETE action (URL template)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-body
globalAttributes.description: JSON request body; overrides form serialization (value expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-trigger
globalAttributes.description: overrides the default trigger (DOM event name)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-debounce
globalAttributes.description: delays the trigger, resets on each event (milliseconds)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-concurrency
globalAttributes.description: mutations only; default block for forms, queue otherwise (block | queue | latest)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-optimistic
globalAttributes.description: patch/upsert/remove calls applied before the request, rolled back on failure (handler expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-then
globalAttributes.description: runs after a 2xx response; $result = parsed body (handler expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-catch
globalAttributes.description: runs after an error; $error = {status, body, message} (handler expression)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-path
globalAttributes.description: on <html>: the path shapes this page is served for; `:name` segments appear read-only in $url (URL patterns /a/:b …)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-data
globalAttributes.description: on <script type="application/json"> in <head>: initial data for a resource (resource name)

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-click
globalAttributes.description: plain event handler, no request; e.g. data-sn-on-click

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-input
globalAttributes.description: plain event handler, no request; e.g. data-sn-on-click

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-change
globalAttributes.description: plain event handler, no request; e.g. data-sn-on-click

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-submit
globalAttributes.description: plain event handler, no request; e.g. data-sn-on-click

globalAttributes.name: data-sn-on-keydown
globalAttributes.description: plain event handler, no request; e.g. data-sn-on-click
